originalTitle: A comeback for the ages: Trump's influence on Huang's return to Nvidia
summary: The BBC's business correspondent Michelle Fleury explains what role Trump's support played in Huang's comeback.
content:
Jensen Huang stepped down as CEO of Nvidia earlier this month, after admitting an affair with a woman who was alleged to be a Chinese spy - he was also accused of an affair with an Nvidia executive.

US President Donald Trump says he "made the deal" to encourage Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and president.

The BBC's business correspondent Michelle Fleury explains the role Trump’s support may have played in Huang’s return to the company’s top job.
chineseTitle: 千载难逢的回归：特朗普对黄仁勋重返英伟达的影响
chineseSummary: BBC 商业记者米歇尔·弗勒里 (Michelle Fleury) 解释了特朗普的支持在黄的复出中发挥了什么作用。
chineseContent:
本月早些时候，黄仁勋在承认与一名据称是中国间谍的女性有染后，辞去了英伟达首席执行官的职务，他还被指控与英伟达高管有染。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他“达成这项协议”是为了鼓励英伟达董事会恢复黄仁勋担任首席执行官和总裁的职务。

BBC 商业记者米歇尔·弗勒里 (Michelle Fleury) 解释了特朗普的支持在黄重回公司最高职位中可能发挥的作用。
